$comment: Shared, committed Claude Code settings for balances-v2 (ADR-0057). Personal
which is gitignored. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} so this file is portable
across clones; never hardcode an absolute path here.
model + effortLevel pin the orchestrator's tier and effort. 'opus' is an
alias, so the model behind it floats. They are a default, not enforcement:
/effort, --effort and CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL all win, the env var over
everything. Role agents pin their own effort in .claude/agents/*.md
frontmatter, which overrides the session level.
CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 turns off the built-in 'fork' agent type. While
forks are on, every subagent runs in the background, so the foreground-
dispatch rule in CLAUDE.md could not be followed. balances-v2 delegates only
to its role agents, never to forks.
The Agent hook makes every subagent spawn a permission prompt.
